module_summary: AXI-stream tap: a 4-state FSM copies observed tap beats into a skid-buffered output, and on output backpressure truncates the frame with a tlast beat marked bad in tuser.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/TRANSFER/TRUNCATE/WAIT controller selecting copy, truncate or drop.

anchors.name: tap_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Observed stream data copied to output when output ready.

anchors.name: tap_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Tapped valid; with tap ready marks a transferred beat.

anchors.name: tap_axis_tready
anchors.why: Tapped ready observed to detect beat transfers.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output copy data from m_axis_tdata_reg.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output valid from m_axis_tvalid_reg.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Output ready steering output/temp register transfers.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Internal ready of output skid stage; failure mid-frame triggers truncation.

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid temp register holding a beat while output stalled.

anchors.name: tap_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Tapped end-of-frame ending TRANSFER/WAIT and tracking frame state.

anchors.name: m_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Output end-of-frame, forced on truncation beat.

anchors.name: m_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Output user sideband carrying bad-frame marker on truncation.

anchors.name: frame_reg
anchors.why: In-frame flag deciding WAIT versus IDLE after truncation.

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Temp register occupied flag affecting internal ready.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Loads output registers directly from internal datapath.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_temp
anchors.why: Loads temp registers when output stalled.

anchors.name: store_axis_temp_to_output
anchors.why: Moves temp registers into output registers.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata_int
anchors.why: FSM-selected beat data: tapped data or zero truncation beat.

anchors.name: store_last_word
anchors.why: Captures sideband of beat where truncation begins.

anchors.name: last_word_user_reg
anchors.why: Held tuser of truncated beat, merged with bad-frame value.

anchors.name: tap_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Tapped user sideband passed or captured on truncation.

groups.name: Tap controller
groups.description: FSM forwarding tapped beats, truncating and waiting for frame end.

groups.name: Tap input
groups.description: Passive monitor of the tapped stream handshake.

groups.name: Output skid buffer
groups.description: Output and temp registers forming a registered skid buffer.
